item.title: Ninajirachi Dominates 2026 AIR Awards Nominations
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news and trends. Today, we're talking about the upcoming AIR Awards, and one artist who's making waves in the music industry: Ninajirachi. Let's get started!"
[Music transitions to a brief electronic dance music clip]
Host: "Ninajirachi, whose real name is Nina Wilson, is a rising star in the EDM scene. Her debut album, 'I Love My Computer', has been a huge success, and she's been flying high on the international festival circuit. Just last year, she won three awards at the ARIA Awards, and took home the Australian Music Prize for album of the year."
[Music transitions back to the main theme]
Host: "And it looks like Ninajirachi's success is set to continue, with her and her team shortlisted in 10 categories at the AIR Awards, including independent album and single of the year. Her label, NLV Records, is also up for independent label of the year. The awards will be presented on July 30th at the Adelaide Town Hall, and will feature a range of other talented artists, including Teen Jesus And The Jean Teasers, Spacey Jane, and John Butler."
[Music transitions to a brief clip of Ninajirachi's music]
Host: "The AIR Awards were established in 2006 to recognize and celebrate the success of Australia's independent music sector. This year, the awards have introduced some new categories, including best independent dance/club single and best independent electronic single. These changes aim to spotlight different types of electronic music, from club-driven tracks to broader electronic artistry."
[Music transitions back to the main theme]
Host: "The South Australian Government is supporting the event, and Minister for Arts Kyam Maher MLC says, 'We're proud to welcome nominees, industry leaders, and delegates from around the world to South Australia.' The AIR Awards will be part of the Indie-Con Australia Conference and A2IM's Indie Week Australian Edition, which runs from July 29th to 31st."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's episode. We'll be keeping an eye on the AIR Awards and Ninajirachi's rising star. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
